compliance.summary: The article’s About GoGloby block and CTA sell AI implementation squads for CX BPO providers, rather than GoGloby’s documented Data & AI recruiting and staffing services. The page also contains unsupported or conflicting claims about guarantees, security coverage, timelines, and the author’s credentials.

llm_problems.title: AI implementation positioning
llm_problems.rule: decisions.md: Company description; Fact Sheet: Identity
llm_problems.issue: The page presents GoGloby as an AI staffing partner for CX providers, not as a staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers.
llm_problems.fix: Change the GoGloby description to match the approved company description and documented services.
llm_problems.subject: GoGloby description
llm_problems.source_value: Staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers

locations.quote: GoGloby is an AI staffing partner that helps customer experience and CX BPO providers
locations.reason: This labels GoGloby as an AI staffing partner serving CX providers instead of using its approved company description.

locations.quote: engineering standard behind 4x Applied AI Engineering
locations.reason: This frames GoGloby around an Applied AI Engineering concept rather than its staffing and recruiting services.

locations.quote: Applied AI Software Engineers are vetted against
locations.reason: This describes GoGloby’s engineers using an Applied AI Software Engineers label instead of the documented Data & AI Engineers positioning.
